    MEYERS MANX 2.0

    The Meyers Manx 2.0 EV carries the spirit of Bruce Meyers’ first dune buggy into a new chapter.

    MEYERS MANX 2.0

    SEATING CAPACITY

    2 seats

    BATTERY CAPACITY

    45+ kWh LFP *

    RANGE

    100+ Miles *

    0-60MPH

    <5.0 seconds *

    REBIRTH OF AN ICON

    Its hand-finished fiberglass body keeps the iconic curves, now paired with an advanced electric powertrain for instant acceleration, quiet cruising, and zero emissions.
